    Profile

    Hercule is one of the ancient killers from Ragna, manifested from the seven heavenly virtues. She supports her allies with a calming judgment through her truthful virtue and hope. The strong swing of her axe has the power to inspire her allies and able to wipe out any oncoming enemies.

    Origin: Ragna
    Gender: Female
    Height: 166cm
    Weight: 51kg
    Birthday: Aug 16
    Blood Type: Type B
    Zodiac: Leo
    Likes: Apple Wine
